about: Summerside is a city on Prince Edward Island’s south shore, on Bedeque Bay opposite the Northumberland Strait. It is the island’s second-largest urban centre after Charlottetown, with a harbour waterfront, historic downtown, and former air-force base lands now used for business and recreation. About 16,000 people live in Summerside.
seoSummary: PEI’s second city on Bedeque Bay—harbour waterfront, historic downtown, and south-shore service hub.
